findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS)
 * @description User input used in regular expressions can cause catastrophic backtracking
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 *        external/cwe/cwe-400
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "split", "sub"]).getACall()
  ) and
  exists(DataFlow::Node pattern |
    pattern = call.getArg(0) and
    // Look for complex patterns with nested quantifiers
    exists(string s |
      s = pattern.asExpr().(StrConst).getText() and
      s.regexpMatch(".*[*+]{2,}.*|.*(\\([^)]*[*+]){2,}.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Potentially vulnerable regular expression pattern that could cause ReDoS"
findings.hypothesis: Regular expression denial of service (ReDoS) from user-controlled regex patterns or input against complex regex patterns
